blocks.content:
Added by the 73rd Amendment.

Contains 29 subjects including:
• Agriculture
• Rural housing
• Drinking water
• Roads
• Poverty alleviation

Questions are often asked on the number of subjects.

items: Questions in competitive exams frequently ask for the exact number of subjects (29 subjects) in the Eleventh Schedule.
Ensure you associate the 73rd Amendment specifically with the addition of the Eleventh Schedule.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Eleventh Schedule was added to the Constitution by the 73rd Amendment.
It specifies a total of 29 functional subjects.
Key subjects include Agriculture, Rural housing, Drinking water, Roads, and Poverty alleviation.
